summary: Dependency-confusion beacon on @grabcad scope exfiltrates host identifiers to bare-IP endpoint
details: Package publishes to the scoped name `@grabcad/company-server-shared` at an inflated version `99.0.1` with an inert Proxy body (`index.js` returns no-op stubs for every property access). The `postinstall` script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and `index.js` fires the same code on `require()`. `beacon.cjs` POSTs JSON containing the package name, `os.hostname()`, the install directory, `process.cwd()`, and the Node version to the hardcoded bare-IP cleartext endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The shape — scoped-name squat at an implausibly high version, no real library behavior, and an install-time/require-time host-identifier beacon to an attacker-controlled IP — is a dependency-confusion reconnaissance attack intended to identify internal build systems that resolve the public name over a private registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
